annotations.title: Create a live day-of schedule page

description: Use when the user wants a shareable run-of-show or day-of schedule for a wedding, conference, shoot or other event that guests or crew can open on their phone and that updates live when edited. Creates the page and returns a view link to share with everyone and a private edit link to keep. Start from a template (wedding, conf, shoot, blank) or pass your own items. Example: {"name": "Maya and Sam wedding", "date": "2026-09-12", "timezone": "America/New_York", "template": "wedding"} or {"name": "Offsite", "items": [{"time": "09:00", "title": "Welcome", "duration_minutes": 30}]}. Creates a saved page, so only call it when the user wants one.

who.description: Vendors or roles on this slot

template.description: Starter schedule. Ignored if items are given.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York. Default UTC.
